intent: Only a release an operator has read enters search and the catalog, and only while what readers find is still what the operator read.
observable_outcome: An approved, current release of a Skill publication appears in anonymous search and detail; a new release, changed text, a revocation or a governance change removes it on the next read.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Operators see publications whose newest release has no conclusion, and the exact text search holds for that release with the current review sequence.
Approving or revoking needs a reason and the release and sequence the operator saw; a stale premise is refused, and the review and its audit event share one transaction.
A redistribution verdict other than allowed cannot be approved.
Only a publication whose newest release carries an unrevoked approval, that is listed, available and allowed, enters search, browse and counts, checked on the same read.
